components.registration: possession-v2.9 (possession/register.py): broadcast ball registered through shared players and smoothed, before the accuracy gate
components.goalkeeper_team_correction: possession-v2.11 (possession/keeper2.py): goalkeeper track pieces found under the id of the team that does not defend their goal are moved to the defending team in the tracking the models see (whole half: most of the goal's evidence is under the other id; shorter: the piece continues a goalkeeper piece); noise gate, broadcast alignment, registration and accuracy gate use the ids as given
components.second_half_kickoff: play blocks = the organisers' graded windows (as possession-v2.11g); then the Smart Tagging kick-off rule of possession-v2.11k (possession/kickoff.py); the kick-off frame published in FAQ.md is not used
components.second_model: possession-v2.15: on the v2.1 path the second-stage probabilities of the v2 models are pooled (arithmetic pool, weight 0.2; possession/pooling.py) with a temporal convolution network (possession/tcn/, models/possession-tcn-v215.npz, three members) and decoded by the unchanged v2 decoder; on the v2.3 path nothing is pooled
components.added_players: possession-v2.16: when the accuracy gate of the broadcast fill is open, broadcast players that, after the alignment and the player-based registration, have no tactical player of either team within 1.5 m are added to the tracking the models see (possession/playerfill.py); the goalkeeper team check then runs on the tracking with the added players. Tactical positions are never moved. Without broadcast files or with the gate closed nothing is added

selection.rule: all seven registered gates passed on 16 new corrupted copies of four external validation matches with a simulated second camera: +0.0104 spellF1 over possession-v2.15 (DFL +0.0098, Metrica +0.0111; 13 better, 3 worse, worst -0.0056); medium stream +0.0073; stream that loses and invents players +0.0044; copies of the other simulator +0.0004

evidence_limits: the second camera is simulated; in three of the four conditions it never loses or invents a player inside its window. The gate on the copies of the other simulator passed by 0.0004 (three of four copies lower). Validation matches and simulators had been used before; only the copies were new. Without broadcast files or with the gate closed the output is that of possession-v2.15

tcn_training.data: six open DFL matches (CC BY 4.0), replicas of both corruption simulators
